title: Persist masterSeed
plan_reference: ADR-001 — Quest Engine Reconciliation & Opportunity Foundation
objectives: Add masterSeed field to gameplay store
Initialize masterSeed once at run creation
Inject RNG derived from masterSeed into TimeEngine
invariants: Persistence: Use PersistenceService only - no direct localStorage
State Management: Zustand for shared domain state
Determinism: masterSeed must never regenerate on load
Telemetry: master_seed_initialized event fires exactly once per run

operations.description: Add masterSeed field to src/engine/game/idleVillage/store.ts (or equivalent Zustand store), initialize once at run creation
Implement persistence of masterSeed via PersistenceService in the store
Update TimeEngine to accept injected rng derived from masterSeed via deriveSeed(masterSeed, 'timeEngine')
Create tests/unit/idleVillage/masterSeed.test.ts with persistence roundtrip and no regeneration on load tests

guardrails: DO NOT use direct localStorage - must use PersistenceService
DO NOT regenerate masterSeed on load - must persist
DO NOT fire master_seed_initialized more than once per run
acceptance_criteria: masterSeed field exists in gameplay store
telemetry event master_seed_initialized fires exactly once per run
TimeEngine accepts injected RNG from masterSeed
notes: T3 depends on T2 (RngService). This is the persistence half of D2.
